proposed.text: A mixed-occupancy building has ground-floor commercial with upper-floor residential. A change of use affecting only the ground floor is proposed. Under PD 1096, which provision MUST also be considered alongside Sec. 702?

options.text: Sec. 701 (Occupancy Classification) only, without considering the interaction between existing and proposed occupancies
Sec. 703 (Mixed Occupancy) — to determine how the new occupancy combination is classified and separated
Sec. 708 (Group A Dwellings) — because any change triggers residential requirements regardless of floor affected
Sec. 704 (Location on Property) — because the building footprint may change due to the new ground floor use

proposed.rationale: Mixed-occupancy buildings are among the most complex compliance scenarios. The interaction between Sec. 702 (change of use) and Sec. 703 (mixed occupancy classification) can create layered requirements. Option A (Sec. 701 only) is incomplete — Sec. 703 specifically governs mixed-occupancy buildings. Options C and D introduce irrelevant sections.
